item.title: SPAR Austria Group continues expansion
item.description: SPAR Austria Group continues expansion ➡️ In 2025, the SPAR Austria Group generated sales of €22.3 billion with 3,326 stores in Austria and five neighbouring countries. This represents a total growth of 4% in their food retail, sports retail, and shopping centre business. In total, the company employed more than 93,000 people, with 51,000 in Austria. SPAR strengthened its lead in Austria’s food retail market, earning €10.8 billion in sales. #SPAR #Retail #RetailExpansion #AnnualResults #FoodReta

item.title: SPAR Norway building ultra-fast grocery delivery
item.description: SPAR Norway building ultra-fast grocery delivery **LINK** SPAR Norway launched its new SPAR QuickCommerce solution to meet current customer requirements for speed and convenience. Through this new quick-commerce solution, customers can receive their groceries in as little as 20-45 minutes, without adding complexity or cost for local SPAR Norway retailers.

item.title: SPAR Austria cuts 5,300 tons of sugar from its own brand products
item.description: SPAR Austria cuts 5,300 tons of sugar from its own brand products ➡️ With 78 grams per person, the average daily sugar consumption in Austria remains above the WHO recommendation of a maximum of 50 grams per day. This makes it all the more important for companies like SPAR Austria to continue their efforts to reduce sugar in their products. Since the launch of SPAR Austria’s sugar reduction initiative in 2017, the retailer has cut around 5,300 tons of sugar from its own brand products. #SPAR #Su
